exposure: access to 'Feel the ViBe' internet-based self-support method
access to the 'Feel the ViBe' (FtV) internet-based self-support method
outcome: Depression (DEP) subscale of the Symptom CheckList-90-R (SCL-90) score
Anxiety (ANX) subscales of the SCL-90 score
cohort: Adolescents and young adults (AYAs) aged 12-25 years who had been exposed to family violence
finding: While no significant changes were found on the IES, promising results were observed in the SCL-90 DEP and ANX subscales, suggesting that the 'Feel the ViBe' intervention may be beneficial for reducing depression and anxiety in AYAs exposed to family violence.
